title: ERRE-Sandbox
description:
A local-LLM multi-agent research apparatus that re-implements the cognitive habits of historical thinkers as agents in a 3D space, in order to study deliberate inefficiency and embodied return.

The system separates a deterministic simulation plane (physics, memory geometry, RNG, clocks, identifiers) from a recorded/replayed LLM-invocation plane. This allows byte-identical reproduction of runs across operating systems even though a non-deterministic language model sits inside the loop. Replay consumes committed records, so the byte-parity claim can be verified without running a language model or a GPU.
